title: Require Native Service oRPC Composition
forbids: a standalone base not constructed directly by named runtime implementEffect(contract, ...), with an optional native .$context<...>() seed; standalone implementEffect authority outside root base.ts; an exported standalone service not rooted directly on the imported base; an embedded API service not rooted directly on named runtime implement(contract).$context<...>(); API implement authority outside root impl.ts; a module not rooted on the matching current-owner service branch; a root router without the exact nonaliased runtime service import from ./impl and the direct untyped export const router = service.router({ ... }); a module-router binding that does not survive at runtime; a root branch that is not a shorthand or spread completed module-router binding; a root helper, remapping, detached or chained builder, nested call, extra export, or import other than the configured service and completed module routers; or a runtime namespace import from an oRPC composition vendor
why: One direct native first hop keeps contract implementation and context ownership visible without a second implementer or composition framework. At the root, the pinned configured oRPC implementer completes the assembled module branches through its native router operation, which enhances the result and attaches the hidden contract relation. Module router composition remains independently owned by router authorship.
remediate: Construct the sole standalone implementer in base.ts with named implementEffect(contract, ...) and seed its native context there when the service declares one; derive standalone service directly from imported base plus named native middleware, construct the sole embedded API implementer in root impl.ts with named implement(contract).$context<...>(), and derive each module from its matching imported service.<module> branch. Author handlers in named module router files, compose their completed exports at module/router.ts, then import the exact runtime service binding from ./impl and runtime completed module routers from exact ./modules/<module>/router paths before directly exporting service.router({ branches }); an embedded API with no modules exports service.router({}).
message: Service composition must preserve direct native ownership and complete the root through the configured service.router(...).
